editorialFeatures.title: Subaru Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive & Boxer Powertrain
editorialFeatures.lead: Permanent active torque distribution, X-Mode with hill descent, and 220mm ground clearance for confidence on every Kenyan journey.
narrative: The 2019 Subaru XV 2.0i-L combines Subaru’s signature FB20 Boxer engine with the renowned Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive system.
With a generous 220mm ground clearance and electronic X-Mode, it tackles sandy coastal beaches, rainy flash floods, and unpaved upcountry tracks with effortless composure.

slides.title: FB20 Boxer Engine Bay
slides.subtitle: Horizontally Opposed Architecture
slides.description: Low-slung engine layout providing superior balance and lower vibration compared to inline engines.

editorialFeatures.title: Driver-Focused Cockpit with EyeSight Assist
editorialFeatures.lead: Signature orange contrast stitching, multi-function touch display, and stereo-camera active safety assist.
narrative: Inside the cabin, the Subaru XV pairs resilient dark upholstery with sporty orange contrast stitching on the seats, dashboard, and gear shifter.
The dual stereo-camera EyeSight system continuously monitors the road ahead, providing adaptive cruise control and pre-collision hazard warnings.

slides.title: Driver Cockpit & Controls
slides.subtitle: Multi-Function Leather Steering
slides.description: Intuitive steering controls, climate dials, and high-visibility digital cluster.

chapters.title: Sporty, AWD Confidence & Adventure-Ready in Mombasa
narrative: The 2019 Subaru XV delivers the ideal combination of rugged crossover capability and daily hatchback economy.

Equipped with Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive, EyeSight safety suite, and 220mm clearance, this unit is available for viewing and delivery at Alberka Enterprises showroom next to Ganjoni Primary School, Mombasa.
